source: • Floating point is finite precision. Reordering additions and reductions can produce small numerical differences from another implementation. ZXNAME0000XZ explicitly warns that ZXNAME0001XZ backends can differ because floating-point operations are fused and ordered differently.[10, 13]
zh: • 浮点是有限精度的。重新排序添加和减少可能会与其他实现产生微小的数值差异。 ZXNAME0000XZ 明确警告 ZXNAME0001XZ 后端可能会有所不同，因为浮点运算的融合和顺序不同。[10, 13]
